update.releaseNotes:
v1.3.4 - Accurate end-of-career stats, a stat-OCR fix, and an opt-in Trackblazer training mode
- Fixed: the end-of-career summary now logs the true final stats and fan count; the post-finale read was sitting just under the detection threshold and silently failing, so it had been recording the pre-finale values. - Fixed: a stat corrupted by two consecutive failed OCR reads can no longer lock in -- the last good value is kept -- and the plausibility cap holds even on a fresh install before the first settings save. - New: an opt-in irregular-training mode for Trackblazer (off by default, experimental). On a free turn it trains instead of racing when the training is clearly worth more; it never touches mandatory or scheduled races.
